early_warning_flag.description: A flag to be posted when or if an early warning event is configured. Section 8.3.

early_warning_radii.description: If true, a visual range circle is posted to convey the range at which an early warning will be triggered. The default is false. Section 8.3.

early_warning_time.description: The number of seconds, before a contact alert is generated, when an early warning event posting is made, if configured. Section 8.3.

echo.description: A mapping from one MOOS variable to another constituting an echo. Section 2.1.

echo_latest_only.description: If true, only the latest value of variable will be echoed on each iteration, even if several pieces of incoming mail have been received since the last posting. Legal values: true, false. The default is false. Section 2.1.

enable_flag.description: A flag to be posted whenever a contact is enabled. Section 8.2.5.

enable_var.description: The name of a MOOS variable for receiving requests for enabling contacts. If no variable is configured, the contact manager will not be able to receive requests for enabling. Section 8.2.

encounter_dist.description: The distance, in meters, within which the CPA between a vehicle and obstacle is considered to be an encounter. The default is 30 meters. Section 2.1.

encounter_flag.description: A MOOS variable and value posted upon the detection of an encounter. Section 2.2.
A MOOS variable and value posted upon the detection of an encounter between a vehicle and an obsacle. Section 2.2.

encounter_range.description: The inter-vehicle range, within which the CPA is considered to be an encounter. Section 2.1.

event.description: A description of a single event in the timer script. Section 2.1.
A description of a single event in the timer script. Section 2.1.

ewarn_radii_color.description: The color of a range circle associated with a configured early warning. Section 8.3.

exponential_decay.description: Determines if the there is an exponentially decaying with range probability of detection beyond the reach distance + reply distance. Default is false. Section 2.5.

extrap_enabled.description: If true (the default is false), then a node report is not generated on every iteration, but can instead be held back for some time, assuming the consumers of the node reports are capable of extrapolating the vehicle position. This can reduce network traffic and log file size, but must be used with care and when sure that consumers are capable of extrapolation. Section 2.4.

extrap_hdg_thresh.description: If extrapolation is enabled, this parameter, in degrees, determines a threshold for posting a new node report. If the vehicle heading has changed by degrees set here, a new node report must be posted. The default is 1 degree. Section 2.4.

extrap_max_gap.description: If extrapolation is enabled, this parameter, in seconds, determines a threshold for posting a new node report. If node report has not been published in the time set here, a new node report must be posted. The default is 5 seconds. Section 2.4.

extrap_pos_thresh.description: If extrapolation is enabled, this parameter, in meters, determines a threshold for posting a new node report. If the vehicle position has changed by this distance, a new node report must be posted. The default is 0.25 meters. Section 2.4.

fail_condition.description: A logic condition that must not be satisfied or otherwise the overall mission will be considered successful. Section 3.1.
When any fail condition is unsatisfied, the query will result ina return value of zero. Section 4.2.

fail_flag.description: A flag to be publish once the result is known and is mission has been deemed to be not successful. Section 3.2.

finish_val.description: A prescribed value for the MOOS variable.

flag.description: A MOOS variable and value to be published.

flip.description: A description of how components from one variable are re-posted under another MOOS variable. Section 2.2.

forward_var.description: A MOOS variable for taking cues to forward time. The default is UTS FORWARD). Section 3.3.
A MOOS variable for taking cues to forward time. The default is UTS FORWARD). Section 3.3.

full_screen.description: If true, viewer is in full screen mode (no appcasts, no fields rendered at the bottom). Legal values: true, false. Section 3.4.

grid_config.description: A portion or all of a grid configuration description. See Listing 2.

grid_viewable_all.description: If false, grids are suppressed from rendering. Legal values: true, false. The default is true.

grid_viewable_labels.description: If false, grid labels are suppressed from rendering. Legal values: true, false. The default is true.

grid_viewable_opaqueness.description: The degree to which grid renderings are opaque. Legal range: [0, 1]. The default is 0.3.

ground_true.description: If true, ground truth reports are also published alongside the normal range reports, with noise removed. This information is not bridge to the vehicles however. Legal values: true, false. The default is true. Section 2.3.

ground_truth.description: If true, ground truth is also reported when noise is added. Section 4.5.

groups.description: If true, inter-vehicle node reports are shared only if two vehicles are in the same group. May be overridden if the two vehicles are within the critical range. The vehicle group designation is typically declared in pNodeReporter. The default is false. Section 2.1.

hash_delta.description: Sets the hash line spacing. Legal values: 50, 100, 200, 500, 1000. The default is 100. Section 3.3.

hash_shade.description: Shade of hash marks. Legal value range: [0, 1]. Zero is black, one is white. Section 3.3.

hash_viewable.description: If true, hash lines are rendered over the op area. Legal values: true, false. The default is false. Section 3.3.

hdg_error.description: A delta heading applied to the heading field for each node report, relative to the otherwise reported heading from NAV HEADING. This feature is used solely to test how downstream consumers/apps that ingest node reports handle a situation where the reported heading and course of ground vary substantially. The default value is 0.

heartbeat_var.description: Names the MOOS variable serving as the heartbeat. Section 4.

history.description: Length of queue used for calculating present speed. The default is 10.

history_var.description: Names the MOOS variable reported in the history mode.

hold_messages.description: If true, messages are held when conditions are not met for later processing when logic conditions are indeed met. Legal values: true, false. The default is true. Section 2.3.

ignore_group.description: A comma-separated list of contact groups to ignore, defined at the global contact manager level. Section 5.1.
A comma-separated lists of group names. Encounters for vehicles in one of these groups will be ignored, if the other vehicle is also in one of these groups. Section 2.5.
If specified, incoming node reports that match this group will be ignored. Introduced after Release 19.8.x.
If specified, incoming node reports that match this group will be ignored. Introduced after Release 19.8.x.

ignore_name.description: A comma-separated list of contact names to ignore, defined at the global contact manager level. Section 5.1.

ignore_range.description: The range in meters, between an incoming point (tracked feature) and ownship, beyond which the point will be ignored.

ignore_region.description: A convex polygon wherein contacts will be ignored, defined at the global contact manager level. Section 5.2.

ignore_type.description: A comma-separated list of contact types to ignore, defined at the global contact manager level. Section 5.1.

infocast_font_size.description: The font size uses in the infocast pane of the set of infocasting panes. Legal values: xlarge, large, medium, small, xsmall. The default is medium. Section 7.4.
Possible settings, xsmall, small, medium,large,xlarge. The de- fault is medium.

infocast_height.description: The height of the appcasting bottom pane as a percentage of the total pMarineViewer window height. Legal values: [30, 35, 40, 45,..., 85, 90]. The default is 75. Section 7.2.

infocast_viewable.description: If true, the infocasting set of panes are rendered on the left side of the viewer. Legal values: true or false. The default is true. Section 7.1.

infocast_width.description: The width of the infocasting panes as a percentage of the total pMarineViewer window width. Legal values: [20, 25, 30, 35,..., 65, 70]. The default is 30. Section 7.2.

interval_policy.description: Either "from start" or "from end", indicating whether the interval of time between utterances is marked from the start of the previous utterance or the end of the previous utterance ("from end").

json_report.description: If true, the node report will be published in JSON format. If set to something other than true, e.g., FOOBAR, a second node report will be published, in JSON format, to FOOBAR, and the normal node report in CSP format will be published as normal. Section 2.8.

keyword.description: Optionally set a keyword. If set, incoming NODE BROKER PING messages must contain this keyword or else they ping will not get a response. Section TBD.

lasso.description: If true, the polygon associated with each cluster will be firmly set to a circular polygon of a set radius and set number of vertices. The default is false. Section 2.1.1.

lasso_points.description: The number of points used in the regular polygon representing the obstacle, if the lasso parameter is set to true. The default is 6, a hexagon. Section 2.1.1.

lasso_radius.description: The radius (distance to any vertex) used in the regular polygon representing the obstacle, if the lasso parameter is set to true. The default is 5 meters. Section 2.1.1.

layout.description: An alternative table layout showing only selected fields in each report.

lclick_ix_start.description: Starting index for the left mouse index macro. Section 12.

lead_condition.description: A logic condition that must be satisfied before the mission can be evaluated. Section 3.1.

left_context.description: Allows the custom configuration of left mouse click context. Section 12.

load_summary.description: If specified, a summary report will be posted to this MOOS variable.

log_the_image.description: If true, a request is posted to pLogger to log a copy of the image and info file. Legal values: true, false. The default is false. Section 3.2.

marker.description: A marker may be stated in the configuration file with the same format of the VIEW MARKER message. Section 5.2.

marker_edge_width.description: Markers are rendered with an outer black edge. The edge may be set thicker to aid in viewing. Legal values: Integer values in the range [1, 10]. The default is 1. Section 5.2.

marker_scale.description: The scale applied to marker renderings. Legal range: [0.1, 100]. The default is 1.0. Section 5.2.

marker_viewable_all.description: If false, markers are suppressed from rendering. Legal values: true, false. The default is true. Section 5.2.

marker_viewable_labels.description: If false, marker labels are suppressed from rendering. Legal values: true, false. The default is true. Section 5.2.

match_group.description: A comma-separated list of contact groups to match, defined at the global contact manager level. Section 5.1.
If specified, vessels must match this group name if it is to be included in the Voronoi decomposition.

match_name.description: A comma-separated list of contact names to match, defined at the global contact manager level. Section 5.1.

match_region.description: A convex polygon outside of which contacts will be ignored, defined at the global contact manager level. Section 5.2.

match_type.description: A comma-separated list of contact types to match, defined at the global contact manager level. Section 5.1.

max_acceleration.description: Maximum rate of vehicle acceleration in m/s2 (0.5).

max_age_per_point.description: The maximum number of seconds that a point (tracked feature) will be retained in memory. Beyond this number, points will be dropped. The default is 20 seconds. Section 3.2.

max_db_uptime.description: The number of seconds, found in the MOOSDB published variable DB UPTIME, after which this app will exit.

max_deceleration.description: Maximum rate of vehicle deceleration in m/s2 (0.5).

max_depth_rate.description: Maximum rate of vehicle depth change, meters per second. The defauls is 0.5. Section 5.4.

max_depth_rate_speed.description: Vehicle speed at which max depth rate is achievable (2.5). Section 5.4.

max_msg_length.description: The total number of characters that may be sent in a string component of a node message. The default is 1000. Section 4.3.

max_noheart.description: The maximum amount of time, in seconds, a missing heartbeat is tolerated before the deadflags are posted. Default is 10. Section 4.

max_pts_per_cluster.description: The maximum number of points (tracked features) retained in memory per cluster (points having the same label). Beyond this number, oldest points will be dropped. The default is 20 points. Section 3.2.

max_retired_hist.description: Maximum amount of contacts held in the contact managers memory at any given time before increasingly more dire measures are taken to remove/retire contacts. Section 7. Limit the number of contacts listed in the CONTACTS RETIRED list to this number. The default is 5, and legal values are in the range [1, 50]. Regardless of this setting, all retired contacts will be included in a CONTACTS RETIRED posting at least once. (Section 3.2).
max_retired_hist.default: 5, and legal values are in the range [1, 50]
max_retired_hist.example: max_retired_hist = 5, and legal values are in the range [1, 50]

mhash_short_var.description: The variable to which the short version of the mission hash is posted. If this parameter is not specified, this information will not be published. This cannot be the same variable as the mission hash var.

min_duration.description: If non-negative, set a random duration for each obstacle no lower than this value. The default is -1. Section 5.2.

min_msg_interval.description: The number of seconds required between messaged sends for any one source vehicle. The default is 30 seconds. Section 4.2.

min_rpt_interval.description: The number of seconds required between report sends for any one source vehicle. The default is -1, meaning no dropping of reports. Section 2.2.

min_utter_interval.description: The minimum time (in seconds) between utterances before a next queued utterance will commence (1.0).

mission_form.description: Set the name of the mission, e.g., "alpha", or "berta" etc., so the MISSION FORM macro can be expanded in any reporting.

mission_hash_var.description: The variable to which the mission hash is posted. The default is MISSION HASH.

msg_color.description: The color of inter-vehicle message comms pulses. The default is "white". Section 5.

msg_flag.description: A variable-value pair posted upon receipt of a valid, un-rejected incoming message and posting to the MOOSDB. Section 6.

msg_groups.description: If true, inter-vehicle node messages are shared only if the two vehicles are in the same group. The vehicle group designation is typically declared in pNodeReporter. The default is false. Section 2.1.

msg_max_hist.description: The number of MOOS mail messages held per variable. Currently multiple messages are only held for string messages. Legal values are any integer value greater than zero. The default is 10.

msg_repeat_color.description: The color of inter-vehicle message comms pulses when the message represents a repeat of a previously dropped message, under mediated message passing. The default is "light green". Section 5.

nav_grace_period.description: A duration, in seconds, before a run warning is posted due to mission navigation information, e.g, NAV LAT or NAV LONG.

near_breach_thresh.description: In addition to normal threshold breaches, the uLoadWatch app may also monitor for near breaches. A near breach occurs when the normal breach thresh is nearly met. For example, if the threshold for a certain app is 2.0, this means a breach is declared if time between app iterations is greater than 2x the normal gap between iterations. If the near breach thresh is set to 1.6, a near breach is declared if the gap reaches 1.6x the normal gap.

near_miss_dist.description: The distance, in meters, within which the CPA between a vehicle and an obstacle is regarded as a near miss. The default is 10 meters. Section 2.1.

near_miss_flag.description: A MOOS variable and value posted upon the detection of a near miss. Section 2.2.
A MOOS variable and value posted upon the detection of a near miss between a vehicle and an obstacle. Section 2.2.

near_miss_range.description: The inter-vehicle range, within which the CPA is regarded as a near miss. Section 2.1.
The range, in meters, within which the CPA between a vehicle and an obstacle is regarded as a near miss. The default is 10 meters. Section 2.1. Same as near miss dist.

node_report_output.description: MOOS variable used for the node report (NODE REPORT LOCAL). Section 2.1.

nodes_font_size.description: The font size used in the nodes pane of the set of infocast- ing panes. Possible settings, xsmall, small, medium, large, or xlarge. The default is large. Section 7.4.
The font size used in the nodes pane of the set of infocast- ing panes. Possible settings, xsmall, small, medium, large, or xlarge. The default is large.

nohelm_threshold.description: Seconds after which a quiet helm is reported as AWOL. Legal values: any non-negative value. The default is 5 seconds. Section 2.2.

nowatch.description: A process or list of MOOS processes to not watch.

obstacle_file.description: A file with obstacle position and size location. Sections 2.3 and 2.4.

obstacles_color.description: When the obstacle manager is rendering obstacles (post view polys is true), this parameter will set the obstacle color. The default value is blue.

oparea.description: A specification of the operation area boundary for optionally rendering.

oparea_viewable_all.description: If false, oparea lines are suppressed from rendering. Legal values: true, false. The default is true.

oparea_viewable_labels.description: If false, oparea label is suppressed from rendering. Legal values: true, false. The default is true.

os_mode.description: Either "osx or "linux" or "both". The default is "both"

pass_condition.description: A logic condition that must be satisfied for the overall mission to be consid- ered successful. Section 3.1.
When all pass conditions are met, the query will result in a return value of zero. Section 4.1.

pass_flag.description: A flag to be publish once the result is known and is mission has been deemed to be successful. Section 3.2.

pause_var.description: A MOOS variable for receiving pause state cues (UTS PAUSE). Section 3.1.
A MOOS variable for receiving pause state cues (UTS PAUSE). Section 3.1.

paused.description: If true, posting of reports is suspended. The default is "false". With release 15.3.
If true, uHelmScope launches in the paused mode. Legal values: true, false. Default value is true.
A Boolean indicating whether the script is paused upon launch. Legal values: true, false. The default is false. Section 3.1.
A Boolean indicating whether the script is paused upon launch. Legal values: true, false. The default is false. Section 3.1.

ping_color.description: Visual preference: color of initiating ping message. Legal values: any color in the Colore Appendix. The default is white.

ping_payments.description: How pings treated w.r.t. ping wait time (”upon response”). Section 4.4. ping wait: Mandatory number of seconds between successive vehicle pings. Section 4.4. report vars: Determines variable name(s) used for range report (”short”). rn algorithm: Algorithm for adding random noise to range measurements. verbose: If true, verbose status message terminal output (false).

ping_wait.description: Minimum seconds enforced between pings. The default is 30. Section 2.7.

plat_report_input.description: A component of the optional platform report. Section 6.

plat_report_output.description: The Platform report MOOS variable. Legal values: conventions for MOOS variable names. The default is PLATFORM REPORT LOCAL. Section 6.

platform_aspect.description: A custom param=value pair to be include in all node reports. Section 2.3.1.

platform_beam.description: The reported beam length (from side-to-side at the widest point) of the platform in meters. Legal values: any non-negative value. The default is zero. Section 2.5.

platform_color.description: A hint on how to render the vehicle in a GUI application like pMarineViewer or alogview. Introduced in Release 16.5. Section 2.5.

platform_group.description: Specify a group name to be include in all node reports. By default empty and nod include in report messages. Can be useful if simulating competitions with teams.
platform_group.default: empty and nod include in report messages

platform_length.description: The reported length of the platform in meters. Legal values: any non- negative value. The default is zero. Section 2.5.

platform_transparency.description: Node reports may include a transparency hint betwen [0,1], with zero being nearly transparent. Some viewers, e.g., pMarineViewer may respect this hint. The default value is 1. When transparency is ommitted from a node report, it is assumed be 1.

platform_type.description: The reported type of the platform. Legal values: any string. The default is "unknown". Section 2.5.

point_var.description: The name of the MOOS variable to looked for tracked features. The default is TRACKED FEATURE. Section 2.1.1.

point_viewable_all.description: If false, points are suppressed from rendering. Legal values: true, false. The default is true. Section 5.1.

point_viewable_labels.description: If false, point labels are suppressed from rendering. Legal values: true, false. The default is true. Section 5.1.

poly_duration.description: Duration, in seconds, associated with the posted polygon for rendering a Voronoi cell. The default is 100 seconds.

poly_edge_color.description: Color of obstacle polygon edges. The default is "gray50".

poly_edge_size.description: Size of obstacle polygon edges. The default is 1.

poly_fill_color.description: Color of obstacle polygon interior. The default is "white".

poly_label_color.description: Color of obstacle polygon labels. The default is "invisible".

poly_label_thresh.description: When the number of obstacle polygons is greater than this parameter, the view polylgons will be published with a label color of invisible, resulting in less work for the pMarineViewer. The default is 25. This is solely to help boost performance of pMarineViewer in extreme uses cases of very large numbers of obstacles and high time warp, and possibly slower machines. It does not affect the function of the obstacle manager in any other way.

poly_shade_thresh.description: When the number of obstacle polygons is greater than this parameter, the view polylgons will be published with a shade (fill) color of invisible, resulting in less work for the pMarineViewer. The default is 100. This is solely to help boost performance of pMarineViewer in extreme uses cases of very large numbers of obstacles and high time warp, and possibly slower machines. It does not affect the function of the obstacle manager in any other way.

poly_transparency.description: Transparency of rendered obstacle polygons. The default is 0.15.

poly_vert_color.description: Color of obstacle polygon vertices. The default is "gray50".

poly_vert_size.description: Size of rendered obstacle polygon vertices. The default is 1.

poly_vertex_thresh.description: When the number of obstacle polygons is greater than this parameter, the view polylgons will be published with a vertex size of zero, resulting in less work for the pMarineViewer by only rendering the polygon edges, without the vertices. The default is 150. This is solely to help boost performance of pMarineViewer in extreme uses cases of very large numbers of obstacles and high time warp, and possibly slower machines. It does not affect the function of the obstacle manager in any other way.

polygon_viewable_all.description: If false, polygons are suppressed from rendering. Legal values: true, false. The default is true. Section 5.1.

polygon_viewable_labels.description: If false, polygon labels are suppressed from rendering. Legal values: true, false. The default is true. Section 5.1.

post_all_ranges.description: If true, the range to all contacts is posted in an ordered, comma-separated list. The default is false. Section 6.1.

post_closest_range.description: If true, the range to the closest contact is posted, rounded to the nearest meter. The default is false (In the release after 17.7).
If true, the range to the closest contact is posted, rounded to the nearest meter. The default is false. Section 6.1.

post_dist_to_polys.description: Legal values are true, false, or close. If true, the distance from ownship to an obstacle is published for each obstacle, to the variable OBM DIST TO OBJ. When set to close, these publications only occur when the obstacle is closer than alert range. When false, these postings are turned of completely. The default is close.

post_mapping.description: A mapping from one posting variable name to another.

post_points.description: If true, sensor points are generated rather than ground truth obstacle polygons. The value false. Section 4.1.

post_policy.description: Either "once", "repeat", or "reset" determines how the deadflags are posted once a heartbeat condition has failed. Section 5.

post_view_polys.description: When true, the obstacle polygons are published published by the obstacle manager. Normally this is redundant since the obstacles are also published by the obstacle avoidance behavior and the obstacle simulator. Legal values are true and false. The default is false.

post_visuals.description: If true, visual posts to VIEW POINT and VIEW POLYGON are generated. The default is true. Section 4.2.

prefer_inerface.description: If multiple interfaces have a valid IP address then a preference can be specified. Valid options are wlan0, wifi, eth0, eth1, usb0, usb1,usb2.

prefix.description: Prefix of MOOS variables published. The default is USM.

procs_font_size.description: The font size used in the procs pane of the set of infocasting panes. Possible settings, xsmall, small, medium, large or xlarge. The default is large. Section 7.4.
Possible settings, xsmall, small, medium, large or xlarge. The default is large.

prox_edge_color.description: Color of Voronoi cell edge color. Default is gray90.

prox_fill_color.description: Color of Voronoi cell internal fill. Default is green.

prox_label_color.description: Color of Voronoi cell labels. Default is white.

prox_vertex_color.description: Color of Voronoi cell polygon vertices. Default is green.

pulse_duration.description: Sets the duration of the visual range pulse posted. Default is 10 seconds. 2.4.

A duration, in seconds, that the comms or node pulse should be viewable. It is a field in VIEW COMMS PULSE message that is respected by at least pMarineViewer to render and slowly fade-out the rendering after this duration. The default is 10 seconds. Section 5.

pulse_range.description: Sets the range of the visual range pulse posted. Default is 20 meters. 2.4.

pulse_render.description: Determines if a visual range pulse will be posted on encounters. Default is true. Section 2.4.

qbridge.description: Shorthand notation for a common bridging pattern. Section 2.5.

rand_var.description: A declaration of a random variable macro to be expanded in event values. Section 4.2.
A declaration of a random variable macro to be expanded in event values. Section 4.2.

range_pulse_viewable_all.description: If false, range pulses are suppressed from rendering. Legal values: true, false. The default is true. Section 5.3.

rate_points.description: When post points is true, this parameter sets the rate of point generation. The default is 5 points, per obstacle, per iteration. Section 4.1.

rclick_ix_start.description: Starting index for the right mouse index macro. Section 12.

reach_distance.description: Distance out to which the pinging vehicle will be heard. Legal values: any numerical value or the keyword "nolimit". The default is 100. Section 2.4.

realmcast_color_scheme.description: Either indigo, beige, hillside, white, or default. The default is hillside. Section 7.8.
Either indigo, beige, hillside, white, or default. The default is hillside.

realmcast_show_community.description: If true, the Community column is shown on realmcast output. Setting to false conserves screen space, possibly enhancing readability. The default is true. Section 7.6.
If true, the Community column is shown on realmcast output. Setting to false conserves screen space, possibly enhancing readability. The default is true.

realmcast_show_masked.description: If true, certain variables are excluded in realmcast output, e.g., virgin variables. Setting to false conserves screen space, possibly enhancing readability. The default is true. Section 7.6.
If true, certain variables are excluded in realmcast output, e.g., virgin variables. Setting to false conserves screen space, possibly enhancing readability. The default is true.

realmcast_show_source.description: If true, the Source column is shown on realmcast output. Set- ting to false conserves screen space, possibly enhancing read- ability. The default is true. Section 7.6.
If true, the Source column is shown on realmcast output. Set- ting to false conserves screen space, possibly enhancing read- ability. The default is true.

realmcast_show_subscriptions.description: If true, the Subscriptions block is shown on realmcast output. Setting to false conserves screen space, possibly enhancing readability. The default is true. Section 7.6.
If true, the Subscriptions block is shown on realmcast output. Setting to false conserves screen space, possibly enhancing readability. The default is true.

realmcast_time_format_utc.description: If true the Time column in realmcast output will be shown in UTC time instead of local time since app startup. The default is false. Section 7.6.
If true the Time column in realmcast output will be shown in UTC time instead of local time since app startup. The default is false.

realmcast_trunc_content.description: If true, the variable Value column in realmcast output will be truncated. Setting to true possibly enhances readability for very long output. The default is false. Section 7.6.
If true, the variable Value column in realmcast output will be truncated. Setting to true possibly enhances readability for very long output. The default is false.

realmcast_wrap_content.description: If true, the variable Value column in realmcast output will wrap onto several lines. Setting to true possibly enhances readability for very long output. The default is false. Section 7.6.
If true, the variable Value column in realmcast output will wrap onto several lines. Setting to true possibly enhances readability for very long output. The default is false.

recap_interval.description: Sets a threshold number of seconds between successive postings of the CONTACTS RECAP variable. This variable may be just too verbose for certain use cases, and if logged, can contribute to log file bloat. The default is one second. It can be shut off completely by setting it to string value "off". Section 3.3.

refresh_interval.description: A minimum interval between node report publications. In seconds. The default is 1. Another way to slow down publications is with the AppTick, but this will also slow down the processing of new spoof requests.
If non-negative, publications to GIVEN OBSTACLE will be reposted evern N seconds where N is the value of this parameter. The default is -1. Section 5.2.

refresh_mode.description: Determines the manner in which appcast requests are sent to apps. Legal values: paused, events, streaming. The default is events. Section 7.3.
Possible settings, paused, events, streaming. The default is events.
Determines when new reports are written to the screen.

region.description: The overall surrounding convex polygon region.

region_edge_color.description: Color of obstacle polygon edges. The default is "gray50". Color of obstacle region edges. The default is "white".

reject_group.description: A comma-separated lists of group names. Encounters for vehicles in one of these groups will be completely disregarded, regardless of the group of the other vehicle. Section 2.5.

reject_range.description: A range, in meters, beyond which new contacts will be ignored, and existing contacts will be dropped. This is one of the guards against unbounded memory growth, discussed in Section 7. The default value is 2000 meters.

relcast_interval.description: Time duration, in seconds, that must occur between the previously generated realmcast and a new one. The allowable range is [0.4, 15]. Values outside this range will be clipped to the range. The default value is 0.8 seconds.

reply_color.description: Visual preference: color of replying message Legal values: any color in Color Appendix. The default is chartreuse.

reply_distance.description: Distance out to which the pinged vehicle will be heard. Legal values: any numerical value or the keyword "nolimit". The default is 100. Section 2.4.

report_all_encounters.description: If true, all encounters will be published in the UCD REPORT, not just near misses or collisions. The default is false.

report_cog.description: If true, node reports will include course over ground (COG) information calculated based on the angle between the current position and previous position. The default is false.

report_column.description: Define a column of output in the in the report file. See Section 3.4.

report_file.description: Name the report file to receive output of results. See Section 3.4.

report_line_format.description: Determines the separator between report columns. By default it is white space, "white", but can also be set to us a comma, "csp".
report_line_format.default: white space, "white", but can also be set to us a comma, "csp

report_vars.description: Determines if CRS RANGE REPORT or CRS RANGE REPORT VNAME, or both are published for individual range reports. Legal settings are short, long, or both. The default is short. Determines variable name style used for range reports. Legal values: short, long, both. The default is long. Section 2.3.

required_nodes.description: The number of nodes required to be detected, before flags are published. By default this is zero.

reset_interval.description: Time, in seconds, between automatic reseting of obstacle locations. The default is -1, indicating disabled resetting. Section 3.1.

reset_max.description: The maximum amount of resets allowed. Legal values: any non-negative integer, or the string "nolimit". The default is "nolimit". NOTE: If re- setting is desired, the reset time parameter must also be changed from its default value of "none". Section 2.3.

The maximum amount of resets allowed. Legal values: any non-negative integer, or the string "nolimit". The default is "nolimit". NOTE: If re- setting is desired, the reset time parameter must also be changed from its default value of "none". Section 2.3.

reset_range.description: Distance, in meters, that all vehicles need to be outside the obstacle region in order for an obstacle reset to be allowed. The default is 10 meters. Section 3.1.

reset_time.description: The time or condition when the script is reset Legal values: Any non-negative number, the string "none", or "all-posted", or equivalently, "end". The default is "none". Section 2.3.
The time or condition when the script is reset Legal values: Any non-negative number, the string "none", or "all-posted", or equivalently, "end". The default is "none". Section 2.3.

reset_var.description: A MOOS variable for receiving reset cues. The default is UTS RESET.
A MOOS variable for receiving reset cues. The default is UTS RESET.

result_flag.description: A flag to be publish once the result is known. Section 3.2.

reuse_ids.description: If false, each time the obstacle field is reset, a unique set of obstacle IDs, i.e., labels, will be generated for the newly generated obstacles. The default is true. Section 3.1.

rider.description: A custom augmentation of the node report can be configured, by registering for one or more MOOS variables and reformatting the output and tagging onto (riding) the end of a node report. Post 24.8. See Section 2.3.2.

right_context.description: Allows the custom configuration of right mouse click context. Section 12.

rn_algorithm.description: Algorithm for adding random noise to the range measurement. Legal parameter values discussed in Section 2.8. The default is no noise.

rotate_speed.description: An external rotational speed in degrees per second (0).

scope.description: A comma separated list of MOOS variables to scope. Section 8.
Description info include in main report along with source info.

script_atomic.description: When true, a started script will complete if conditions suddenly fail. Legal
When true, a started script will complete if conditions suddenly fail. Legal

script_name.description: Unique (hopefully) name given to this script. The default is "unnamed".
Unique (hopefully) name given to this script. The default is "unnamed".

seglist_viewable_all.description: If false, seglists are suppressed from rendering. Legal values: true, false. The default is true. Section 5.1.

seglist_viewable_labels.description: If false, seglist labels are suppressed from rendering. Legal values: true, false. The default is true. Section 5.1.

sensor_arcs.description: Set arcs relative to the heading of the vehicle in which the range sensor is able to detect vehicles. The default is 360 degrees. Section 2.6.

sensor_range.description: The range to an obstacle at which simulated LIDAR point will be generated. The default is 50. Section 4.2.

shared_node_reports.description: When enabled with true, node reports are re-posted to the shoreside community as NODE REPORT UNC. The default is false. This feature may also be more commonly enabled via in incoming message. See UNC SHARED NODE REPORTS. Section 6.

shuffle.description: If true, timestamps are recalculated on each reset of the script. Legal values: true, false. The default is true. Section 2.3.
If true, timestamps are recalculated on each reset of the script. Legal values: true, false. The default is true. Section 2.3.

sim_pause.description: If true, the simulation is paused. The default is false.

source.description: Names a MOOS app for which all variables will be scoped.

spoof.description: A spoof request comprised of the fields found in a node report. The request must contain the vehicle position. All other fields are optional, relying on default values if a field is not specified in the spoof request. If the name is not specified, an auto-generated name will be used, beginning with "C" followed by an index incremented with each spoof request. Note: a spoof request may also be made through an incoming posting to the MOOS variable SPOOF.

stale_remove_thresh.description: Number of seconds after a stale vehicle has been detetected before being removed. When time warp is one, vehicles are not automati- cally removed at all, and this number is meaningless. Legal values: Any non-negative number. The default is 30. Section 6.2.

stale_report_thresh.description: Number of seconds after which a vehicle report will be considered stale. Legal values: Any non-negative number. The default is 60. Section 6.2.

stale_time.description: Time in seconds after which a vehicle will not receive node reports or messages unless a node report has been received by that vehicle. The default is 5 seconds. Section 2.1.

start_depth.description: Initial vehicle depth in meters. The default is zero. Section 4.

start_heading.description: Initial vehicle heading in degrees. The default is zero. Section 4.

start_pos.description: A full starting position and trajectory specification. Section 4.

start_speed.description: Initial vehicle speed in meters per second. The default is zero. Section 4.

start_x.description: Initial vehicle x position in local coordinates. The default is zero. Section 4.

start_y.description: Initial vehicle y position in local coordinates. The default is zero. Section 4.

status_var.description: A MOOS variable for posting status summary. The default is UTS STATUS. Section 5.3
A MOOS variable for posting status summary. The default is UTS STATUS. Section 5.3

stealth.description: A parameter in the range [0,1] for reducing the range other vehicles may otherwise hear the node reports from a source vehicle. The default is 1. Section 3.1.

strict_addressing.description: If true, only messages with a destination specified by dest node, match- ing the local community name are processed. Other messages with a destination specified by a group designation are ignored. The default is false.

strict_ignore.description: if true, both group and type exclusion filtering will reject a contact if the contact is not reporting its group or type information and there are ignore filters. Section 5.1.

summary_interval.description: Time duration, in seconds, between auto-generated postings of REALMCAST CHANNELS. The allowable range is [1, 10]. Values outside this range will be clipped to the range. The default value is 2 seconds.

summary_wait.description: A maximum amount of time between PROC WATCH SUMMARY postings. Nega- tive value indicates posting occurs only when the value changes regardless of elapsed time. Legal values: any numerical value. The default is −1.

temp_file_dir.description: Directory where temporary files are written. Default is "∼/".

terse_reports.description: If true, do not include YAW in node reports.

thresh.description: A gap threshold for reporting a LOAD WARNING. Each threshold line specifies the application name and the gap threshold value.

thrust_factor.description: A scalar correlation between thrust and speed. The default is 20.

thrust_map.description: A mapping between thrust and speed values. Section 8.

thrust_reflect.description: If true, negative thrust is simply opposite positive thrust. The default is false. Section 8.

tiff_file.description: Filename of a tiff file background image. After Release 22.8.x, multiple lines of this parameter will load multiple tiff files. Section 3.2.

tiff_file_b.description: Filename of another tiff file background image. Deprecated after Release 22.8.x: just use multiple tiff file lines. Section 3.2.

tiff_type.description: Parameter no longer supported, after Release 22.8.x

tiff_viewable.description: Use the tiff background image if set to true. Otherwise a gray screen is used as a background. Legal values: true, false. The default it true. Section 3.2.

time_warp.description: Rate at which time is accelerated in executing the script. Legal values: any non-negative number. The default is zero. Section 5.
Rate at which time is accelerated in executing the script. Legal values: any non-negative number. The default is zero. Section 5.

time_zero.description: The base time upon which script event times are based. The default is "script start", the time at which uTimerScript is launched. The one alternative is "db start", the time at which the MOOSDB was launched. The default is "script start".

The base time upon which script event times are based. The default is "script start", the time at which uTimerScript is launched. The one alternative is "db start", the time at which the MOOSDB was launched. The default is "script start".

trails_color.description: The color of trail points rendered behind vehicles to indicate recent vehicle position history. Legal values: Any color listed in the Colors Appendix. The default is white. Section 6.6.

trails_connect_viewable.description: If true the vehicle trail points are each connected by a line. Useful when node reports have large gaps in time. Legal values: true, false. The default is true. Section 6.6.

trails_length.description: The number of points retained for the rendering of vehicle trails. Legal values: Integers in the range [1, 100000]. The default is 100. Section 6.6.

trails_point_size.description: The size of the points rendering the vehicle trails. Legal values: Integers in the range [1, 10]. The default is 1. Section 6.6.

trails_viewable.description: If false, vehicle trails are suppressed from rendering. Legal values: true, false. The default is true. Section 6.6.

trunc_data.description: If true, variable string values are truncated.

trunc_length.description: The number of characters that the value field of an output line will be truncated to, when the user has opted to enable truncated output. Legal values are any integer value greater than zero. It is recommended to choose a number that is a multiple of the wrap length. The default is 270.

try_shore_host.description: A candidate route to send send initial pings in hopes of establishing a connection. The route specifies an input route for pShare running in a shoreside community.

tuncated_output.description: If true, output in the MOOS-scope or behavior-scope section of the report is truncated. This can also be toggled at run time with the ’‘’ key. Legal values: true, false. The default is false.

turn_loss.description: A range [0, 1] affecting speed lost during a turn. The default is 0.85.

turn_rate.description: A range [0, 100] affecting vehicle turn radius, e.g., 0 is an infinite turn radius. The default is 70.

upon_awake.description: Reset or re-start the script upon conditions being met after failure ("n/a"). Section 2.3.
Reset or re-start the script upon conditions being met after failure ("n/a"). Section 2.3.

use_unc_reports.description: If true, obtain node reports from the NODE REPORT UNC variable instead of NODE REPORT. This is done in cases of high time warp and high number of contacts, to reduce load. See the documentation for uFldNodeComms.

values.description: any non-negative numerical value, or range of values separated by a colon. The default is zero. Section 5.2. true, false. The default is false.
any non-negative numerical value, or range of values separated by a colon. The default is zero. Section 5.2. true, false. The default is false.

var.description: A comma-separated list of variables to scope on in the MOOS-Scope block. Multiple lines may be provided. Section 3.
A comma-separated list of variables to scope on in the scoping mode.

vector_viewable_all.description: If false, vectors are suppressed from rendering. Legal values: true, false. The default is true. Section 5.1.

vector_viewable_labels.description: If false, vector labels are suppressed from rendering. Legal values: true, false. The default is true. Section 5.1.

vehicles_active_color.description: The color of the active vehicle (the one who’s data is being shown in the bottom data fields). Legal values: Any color listed in the Colors Appendix. The default is red. Section 6.4.

vehicles_inactive_color.description: The color of inactive vehicles. Legal values: Any color listed in the Colors Appendix. The default is yellow. Section 6.4.

vehicles_name_color.description: Sets the color for rendering the vehicle label. Legal values are any color in the Colore Appendix. The default is white. Section 6.4.

vehicles_name_mode.description: Sets the mode for rendering the vehicle label. Legal values are: names, names+mode, names+shortmode, names+depth, off. The default is names+shortmode. Section 6.1.

vehicles_shape_scale.description: The scale factor applied to vehicle size rendering. Legal values in the range: [0.1, 100]. The default is 1.0. Section 6.3.

vehicles_viewable.description: If false, vehicles are suppressed from rendering. Legal values: true, false. The default is true. Section 6.

verbose.description: If true, status reports are displayed to the terminal during operation. The default is false.
If true, progress output is generated to the console (true).
If true, progress output is generated to the console (true).

view_center.description: Sets the center of the viewing image in x,y local coordinates. Legal values: (double,double). The default is (0,0).

view_node_rpt_pulses.description: If true, comms pulses are rendered between vehicles whenever a node report successfully makes its way from one vehicle to another. The default is true. Section 5.

wait.description: If uQueryDB initially fails, rather than returning with a value of 1 immediatly, it will wait N seconds to receive new mail updates that may perhaps result in successfully satisfying conditions. Default is 0 seconds. Section 4.3.

warning_on_stale.description: If true, generate a warning if a previously known node has not been heard from in more than 10 seconds.

watch.description: One or more comma-separated MOOS process to watch and report on.

watch_all.description: If true, watch all processes that become known either via the DB CLIENTS list or the Antler list. Legal values: true, false. The default is true.

wrap_data.description: If true, variable string values are multi-line wrapped.

wrap_data_len.description: Content line length if wrapping string value output. Default is 45.

wrap_length.description: The number of characters, per line, when the user has opted to have the variable value field wrapped. Legal values are any integer value greater than zero. The default is 90.
